brain.summary: INFEASIBLE AS STATED: inside the goal's own limits the openings held bring at most $0 of the $2,000 still needed, even with every buyer agreeing at the top price. To make it supportable, deadline: move the deadline to at least 46 days from now, when enough lots have settled; or target: lower the target: the openings held bring nothing inside the goal's limits even with every buyer agreeing. The conclusion covers the openings held; markets nobody has counted are not ruled out, so Brain keeps searching for openings outside them.

facts.value: Sell Brain files each well-completion report and permit closeout within 3 days of receiving the driller's log. Signed terms: invoiced on filing, paid net 45 days. to each buyer.
Six drilling contractors signed service orders at $450 per well closeout filing (signed orders, 2026-11).

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and it names the decisive gap the evidence decides. The only opening has six signed orders at $450 (6 x $450 = $2,700; 5 deals = $2,250 would carry $2,000), cost $6 each and no capital, so price, volume, fulfilment (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proven) and economics all hold — but the signed terms are 'invoiced on filing, paid net 45 days', putting the first usable cash at ~day 46 against a 14-day window. That is a constraint, not missing evidence: even with every fact established, settled cash inside the window is $0. The revision cites SETTLES_IN_TIME as the decisive link, matches Brain's own verdict (deadline >= 46 days), and treats renegotiation to card-on-filing as an unmeasured possibility rather than assuming it.
findings: Recomputed: 6 x $450 = $2,700 gross, 6 x $6 = $36 cost; minimum 5 deals ($2,250) for $2,000. Settlement: filing within 3 days of the driller's log + net 45 = ~day 46-48 > 14. Cash in window $0; ledger empty, consistent with the check trace.
Decisive link SETTLES_IN_TIME, constraint DEADLINE with basis timeToFirstCash: correct and cited to the card.

Renegotiation alternative is correctly held as an unknown (nothing on the record shows a driller accepts changed terms); the resolution's re-plan trigger (>=5 written agreements to card-on-filing) carries the target at 5 x $450 = $2,250.

Minor: the agreements are recorded by PERSON as WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE; if re-planned as executable, the re-plan should also confirm when each driller's log arrives, since the 3-day filing clock starts from it.
